results.title: Zelenskyy: Putin plans unannounced mobilisation to pressure Ukraine and Europe
results.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy believes Russian leader Vladimir Putin is planning a covert mobilisation in Russia and intends to use it to exert pressure not only on Ukraine but also on Europe.
